trends.name: Iran War Escalation & Oil Shock
trends.summary: Trump's address escalated Iran conflict rhetoric, contradicting market expectations for de-escalation. Brent crude surged 5% on threats to hit Iran 'extremely hard' within weeks, with conflict expected to last 2-3 more weeks. 10Y yields spike toward 4.40% on geopolitical risk premium; markets pricing significant volatility ahead.

trends.name: Inflation & Monetary Policy Uncertainty
trends.summary: 70% surge in Brent oil from December lows not fully reflected in ISM data; Middle East conflict creating delayed inflation pressures in steel, aluminum, and petroleum products. Fed may struggle to 'look through' energy shock, complicating rate trajectory. True inflation risks emerging despite market complacency.

trends.name: Recession Odds & Labor Market Weakness
trends.summary: Recession probability dropped to 26% as of latest market pricing, but February payrolls came in at 60k with 4.4% unemployment. Challenger job cuts report imminent; Oracle's 30,000 layoffs signal tech sector weakness. Labor market deterioration contrasts with optimistic recession odds.

trends.name: Bitcoin Institutional Adoption & Momentum
trends.summary: Bitcoin snapped 5-month losing streak fueled by institutional inflows and trendline breakout, targeting $80k. Institutional flows accelerating amid macro uncertainty and geopolitical volatility, positioning crypto as alternative risk asset during Iran conflict and inflation concerns.

trends.name: Tech Sector Earnings & Layoff Contagion
trends.summary: Oracle fired 30,000 workers via email; Nike posted its 2nd largest 25-year loss. Tesla delivery update awaited as EV sector faces valuation pressure. Tech earnings season revealing consumer weakness and labor cost pressures spreading across software and hardware.

trends.name: Australia Gambling Regulation Overhaul
trends.summary: Australia's PM Albanese announced major gambling ad restrictions: three-per-hour cap 6AM-8:30PM, sports venue bans, celebrity ad bans, and online promotion restrictions to logged-in 18+. Regulatory pressure on gaming/betting stocks; affects Australian consumer discretionary sector and media ad revenue.

trends.name: Energy & Defense Sector Boom
trends.summary: Oil price surge benefiting energy plays; Thales positioned for Europe defense spending surge amid geopolitical tensions. Iran conflict and NATO tensions driving multi-quarter upside for energy, defense, and aerospace sectors with supply chain safety stock building reported.

trends.name: China Economic Headwinds & Policy Caution
trends.summary: China's central bank withdrew cash from financial system for first time in a year, signaling caution amid oil price inflation pressures. Huawei cloud revenue fell as Chinese AI lagged U.S. rivals; India equities facing deterioration. Asian markets reversing gains on macro weakness.

trends.name: Commercial Real Estate Debt Crisis
trends.summary: Brandywine Realty Trust debt levels hiding real problems; REIT market discounted, raising public listing costs. Starwood Property Trust offering discounted yield with credit risk; sector facing refinancing pressures and valuation compression amid higher rates.

trends.name: Consumer Spending & Retail Weakness
trends.summary: February retail sales plunged despite seasonal adjustments; high gas prices ($4/gallon) dampening discretionary spending sentiment. Calvin Klein parent stabilized investor anxieties, but Sam's Club membership fee hike signals inflation pass-through; consumer resilience under pressure.

trends.name: Spacetech IPO Wave & M&A Activity
trends.summary: SpaceX reportedly made key move signaling jumbo IPO wave potential; Globalstar surged 15% on Amazon acquisition rumors. Aerospace sector gaining momentum from defense spending and space commercialization; strategic acquisition activity reshaping sector consolidation.

trends.name: USD Strength & FX Market Stress
trends.summary: USD/JPY faces bearish RSI divergence with major technical pressure; 10Y yield surge toward 4.40% strengthening dollar. Rising rates and geopolitical safe-haven flows pushing currency volatility higher; implications for EM exposure and international equity valuations.
